notes.subject: ערב רב
notes.rationale: Hebrew alliteration 'erev rav' (mixed rabble), heard as a rhyme; Tok Pisin cannot echo it.

notes.subject: ol man bilong ol kain kain lain
notes.rationale: ערב is a 'mixture / mongrel race' — the shape-word 'mixture' is kept rather than a role word like 'foreigners'.

notes.subject: מקנה
notes.rationale: Hebrew repeats livestock as a summary term after sheep and cattle; rendered as a summarizing apposition.

translation: Na tu, wanpela graunpela ol man bilong ol kain kain lain i go antap wantaim ⟨את⟩ ol; na ol sipsip na meme, na ol bulmakau — ol animal bilong lukautim i stap planti tumas.

tokens.gloss: ol man bilong ol kain kain lain
